text_en: So if you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
text_cn: 你们既然与基督一同复活了，就该追求天上的事，在那里有基督坐在天主的右边。

text_en: Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth,
text_cn: 你们该思念天上的事，不该思念地上的事，

text_en: for you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
text_cn: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命已与基督一同藏在天主内了；

text_en: When Christ who is your life is revealed, then you also will be revealed with him in glory.
text_cn: 当基督，我们的生命显现时，那时，你们也要与他一同出现在光荣之中。

text_en: Put to death, therefore, whatever in you is earthly: fornication, impurity, passion, evil desire, and greed (which is idolatry).
text_cn: 为此，你们要致死属于地上的肢体，致死淫乱、不洁、邪情、恶欲和无异于偶像崇拜的贪婪，

text_en: On account of these the wrath of God is coming on those who are disobedient.
text_cn: 为了这一切，天主的义怒才降在悖逆之子身上；

text_en: These are the ways you also once followed, when you were living that life.
text_cn: 当你们生活在其中时，你们也曾一度在其中行动过，

text_en: But now you must get rid of all such things—anger, wrath, malice, slander, and abusive language from your mouth.
text_cn: 但是现在你们却该戒绝这一切：忿怒、暴戾、恶意、诟骂和出于你们口中的秽言。

text_en: Do not lie to one another, seeing that you have stripped off the old self with its practices
text_cn: 不要彼此说谎；你们原已脱去了旧人和他的作为，

text_en: and have clothed yourselves with the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of its creator.
text_cn: 且穿上了新人，这新人即是照创造他者的肖像而更新，为获得知识的；

text_en: In that renewal there is no longer Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave and free; but Christ is all and in all!
text_cn: 在这一点上，已没有希腊人或犹太人，受割损的或未受割损的，野蛮人、叔提雅人、奴隶、自由人的分别，而只有是一切并在一切内的基督。

text_en: As God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience.
text_cn: 为此，你们该如天主所拣选的，所爱的圣者，穿上怜悯的心肠、仁慈、谦卑、良善和含忍；

text_en: Bear with one another and, if anyone has a complaint against another, forgive each other; just as the Lord has forgiven you, so you also must forgive.
text_cn: 如果有人对某人有什么怨恨的事，要彼此担待，互相宽恕；就如主怎样宽恕了你们，你们也要怎样宽恕人。

text_en: Above all, clothe yourselves with love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.
text_cn: 在这一切以上，尤该有爱德，因为爱德是全德的联系。

text_en: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which indeed you were called in the one body. And be thankful.
text_cn: 还要叫基督的平安，在你们心中作主；你们所以蒙召存于一个身体内，也是为此，所以你们该有感恩之心。

text_en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; teach and admonish one another in all wisdom; and with gratitude in your hearts sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
text_cn: 要让基督的话充分地存在你们内，以各种智慧彼此教导规劝，以圣咏、诗词和属神的歌曲在你们心内，怀着感恩之情，歌颂天主。

text_en: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
text_cn: 你们无论作什么，在言语上或在行为上，一切都该因主耶稣的名而作，借着他感谢天主圣父。

text_en: Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
text_cn: 作妻子的，应该服从丈夫，如在主内所当行的。

text_en: Husbands, love your wives and never treat them harshly.
text_cn: 作丈夫的，应该爱妻子，不要苦待她们。

text_en: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is your acceptable duty in the Lord.
text_cn: 作子女的，应该事事听从父母，因为这是主所喜悦的。

text_en: Fathers, do not provoke your children, or they may lose heart.
text_cn: 作父母的，不要激怒你们的子女，免得他们灰心丧志。

text_en: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only while being watched and in order to please them, but wholeheartedly, fearing the Lord.
text_cn: 作奴隶的，应该事事听从肉身的主人，且不要只当着眼前服事，像是取悦于人，而是要以诚心，出于敬畏主。

text_en: Whatever your task, put yourselves into it, as done for the Lord and not for your masters,
text_cn: 你们无论作什么，都要从心里去作，如同是为主，而不是为人，

text_en: since you know that from the Lord you will receive the inheritance as your reward; you serve the Lord Christ.
text_cn: 因为你们该知道，你们要由主领取产业作为报酬；你们服事主基督罢！

text_en: For the wrongdoer will be paid back for whatever wrong has been done, and there is no partiality.
text_cn: 因为凡行不义的，必要得他所行不义的报应；天主决不看情面。
